verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਤ ਆਵਤ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁ ਕਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: abigat gat kat aavat a(n)tar gat akath kathaa su keh kaise kai sunaieeaai ||

en.bdb: How can the mysteries of the eternal Lord be brought into mind? He cannot be described. How can He be explained through words?

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਿਧੌ ਪਾਈਅਤਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਦਰਸ ਕੋ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: alakh apaar kidhau paieeat paar kaise dharas adharas ko kaise kai dhikhaieeaai ||

en.bdb: How can we reach the beyond end of the infinite Lord? How can the invisible Lord be shown?

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹੀਐ ਧੌ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਲੰਬੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਵਲੰਬ ਠਹਿਰਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: agam agochar agahu gaheeaai dhau kaise nirala(n)b kaun avala(n)b Thahiraieeaai ||

en.bdb: The Lord who is beyond the reach of the senses and perception, how can the Lord who cannot be caught be held and known? The Lord Master needs no support. Who can be assigned as His support?

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਬੀਤੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਜਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੫੩॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sa(n)dh milai soiee jaanai jaa mai beetai bisam bidheh jal boo(n)dh hui samaieeaai ||253||

en.bdb: Only the Guru-conscious seeker experiences the infinite Lord when he himself goes through that state and feels free of his body bondages. He merges with the Guru like a drop of water merges with the sea. (253)
